blocks.title: Malus ka qanoon
blocks.text: Analyzer se guzarne ke baad plane polarized light ki intensity I analyzer aur polarizer ke transmission axes ke darmiyan zawiye theta ke cosine ke murabbe ke seedhe tanasub mein hai: I, cos^2 theta ke tanasub mein, ya I = I0 cos^2 theta, jahan I0 aane wali polarized light (polarizer se guzarne ke baad) ki intensity hai.

blocks.alt: Unpolarized roshni polarizer se guzar kar I0 shiddat ki polarized roshni banti hai. Phir woh analyzer se milti hai jis ka axis polarizer ke axis se zaviye theta par ghooma hai, aur nikalne wali roshni ki shiddat I = I0 cos^2 theta hai. Note kehta hai theta = 0 par sab guzarti hai aur 90 degree par kuch nahi.
blocks.caption: Malus ke qanoon ka khaaka (Figure 8.7a ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Malus ka qanoon pehle polaroid (polarizer) par parti light ki intensity aur doosre polaroid (analyzer) se guzarne ke baad milne wali light ki intensity ka riyazi rishta deta hai, jaisa Fig. 8.7(a) mein hai. Analyzer bhi ek polarizer hai jo pehle wale ke baad rakha jata hai. Analyzer ghumane se polarized light ki intensity badalti hai; yeh light ki intensity mazeed kam karne aur polarizer ke nisbat analyzer ka zawiya badal kar use mutawazan karne ke liye istemal hota hai.

Kuch shaffaf qalmi (crystalline) maadde, jaise tourmaline aur calcite crystals, light waves ki vibrations ko sirf ek satah tak mehdood kar sakte hain. Aise maadde polaroids kehlate hain, jin ki crystal banawat mein simt ki shiddat (directionality) zyada hai. Light reflection, refraction aur bikhrao (scattering) jaise qudrati mazahir se bhi polarized ho sakti hai. Agar polaroid ka tukra polarized shua ke saamne ghumaya jaye to guzarne wali light ki intensity badalti hai; is ki wajah ibtidai polarizer aur doosre polarizer ke axis ka darmiyani zawiya hai.

Jab A0 amplitude ki polarized light analyzer se zawiya theta par takraye to woh do ajza A0 cos theta aur A0 sin theta mein taqseem hoti hai (Fig. 8.7b). Juz A0 sin theta analyzer mein jazb (absorb) ho jata hai. Chunke sirf A0 cos theta analyzer se guzarta hai, guzarti light ka amplitude A = A0 cos theta hai. Chunke intensity I amplitude A ka murabba hai, I = A^2, ya I = A0^2 cos^2 theta, aur I = I0 cos^2 theta (kyunke I0 = A0^2), jahan I0 aane wali polarized light ki intensity hai.

blocks.alt: Polarizer ka axis amoodi aur analyzer ka axis zaviye theta par ghooma hai. Polarizer axis ke saath surkh amplitude A0 ko analyzer axis ke saath hare hisse A0 cos theta (jo guzarta hai) aur us se seedhe zaviye par neele hisse A0 sin theta (jo rukta hai) mein taqseem kiya gaya. Dabba kehta hai shiddat amplitude ke murabba ke mutabiq hai, is liye I = I0 cos^2 theta.
blocks.caption: Amplitude ko A0 cos theta aur A0 sin theta mein taqseem karna (Figure 8.7b ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Agar theta = 0 degrees ho to I = I0: analyzer se guzarti intensity polarizer se guzarne wali ibtidai light ki intensity ke barabar hai.
Agar theta = 90 degrees ho to I = 0: light poori bujh jati hai, yaani analyzer se koi light nahi guzarti.

blocks.text: Crossed polarizers se guzarti light ruk jati hai: amudi polarizer sirf amudi polarized light guzarta hai, jise ufuqi doosra polarizer rok deta hai (For Your Information). Do polarizers crossed hon to un se dekhne par bohat kam light guzarti hai (Do You Know).

blocks.title: Optical activity
blocks.text: Optical activity kuch maaddon ki woh salahiyat hai jis se woh apne andar se guzarti light ki plane of polarization ghuma dete hain. Yeh gardish (rotation) polarizer aur analyzer se pakri jati hai (Fig. 8.8).

Bohat se crystals aur mehlool apne andar se guzarti light ki plane of polarization ghumate hain; aise maadde optically active kehlate hain. Misalein quartz crystals, cinnabar (HgS), cheeni ka pani, insulin aur collagen hain. Gardish ki miqdar aur simt in awamil (factors) par munhasir hai:

items: Maadde ka arhaaz (concentration), yaani kisi mixture ya mehlool ki di hui miqdar mein maadde ki miqdar.
Light ka us mein tay kiya faasla.

blocks.text: Optical activity maadde ke molecules ki ghair-mutanasib (asymmetric) shakal, jaise pech-daar (helical) hone, ki wajah se hoti hai. Aise crystals ki chand millimetre motai plane of polarization ko kai degrees ghuma deti hai. Kuch organic maadde, jaise cheeni aur tartaric acid, mehlool mein optical rotation dikhate hain; optically active maaddon ki yeh khasiyat mehlool mein un ka arhaaz maloom karne ke liye istemal ho sakti hai. Cheeni ka mehlool aane wali light ki plane of polarization ko is tarah ghumata hai ke woh ufuqi na rahe balke zawiya theta par ho; phir analyzer tab light rokta hai jab use amudi (crossed) position se utna ghumaya jaye (Interesting Information).

blocks.alt: Polarizer se aai polarized roshni aik optically active maadde, jaise cheeni ka mahlool ya quartz, ke block se guzarti hai. Nikalte waqt us ka larzne ka plane zaviye theta ghoom jata hai, aur use guzarne dene ke liye analyzer ko bhi utna hi ghumana parta hai.
blocks.caption: Optical activity: polarizer aur analyzer ke darmiyan optically active maadda (Figure 8.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Example 8.2
blocks.text: Agar polarizing angle 54.5 degrees ho to medium ka refractive index nikalein. Hal: theta_p = 54.5 degrees, n = ?. Chunke tan theta_p = n, n = tan 54.5 degrees = 1.4.

blocks.title: Example 8.3
blocks.text: 75 W m^-2 intensity ki polarized light aise analyzer se guzarti hai jis ka axis polarizer ke axis se 30 degrees par hai. Nikalne wali intensity kya hai? Hal: I0 = 75 W m^-2, theta = 30 degrees, I = ?. Malus ka qanoon istemal karte hue I = I0 cos^2 theta = 75 cos^2 30 degrees = 75 (0.866)^2 = 75 x 0.75 = 56.25 W m^-2.

blocks.title: Example 8.4
blocks.text: 5 units amplitude ki polarized light aise polarizer se guzarti hai jis ki electric field asal polarization ki simt se 60 degrees par hai. Analyzer se guzarne ke baad wave ka amplitude nikalein. Hal: A0 = 5 units, theta = 60 degrees, A = ?. Malus ka qanoon istemal karte hue A = A0 cos theta = 5 cos 60 degrees = 5 x 0.5 = 2.5 units.

items: Optics aur photonics: polarized sunglasses, LCD (Liquid Crystal Display) screens aur optical communication systems jaise istemalat ke liye polarization lazmi hai.

Imaging aur microscopy: polarization tasveer ka maiyar barhati hai, chamak (glare, nazar mein khalal dalne wali na-pasandeeda light) kam karti hai aur tazaad (contrast) behtar karti hai, khaas kar microscopy aur tibbi imaging mein.
Tibbi istemalat: polarization cancer ki tashkhees, tissue imaging aur laser surgery mein istemal hoti hai, kyunke yeh mukhtalif tissues mein farq kar sakti hai.
Astronomy: polarization kaainati mazahir, jaise door sitaron ki light ya cosmic microwave background radiation ki polarization, ka tajziya karne mein madad deti hai.
Mukhtalif shobe: optics aur photonics, imaging aur microscopy, biology aur chemistry, communication systems waghaira.

blocks.text: Polarizers, jinhein polarizing filters bhi kehte hain, ke do bare istemalat hain.

items: Asmaan ki photography: badalon ki tasveer lene wale camera par polaroid laga hota hai, jo asmaan se aati light polarize karta hai. Polarizers fiza mein molecules ke chhote zarron se light ke bikhrao se paida hone wali chamak aur dhundlahat (haze) kam karte hain. Yeh had se zyada roshan safed light rok kar (print mein 'clocking') aur baqi rangon ko guzar kar tazaad bhi barhate hain, jis se zyada roshan aur tafseeli tasveer banti hai aur tasveer ka majmooi maiyar behtar hota hai.

Maaddon ka stress analysis: materials science mein polarizers plastics, dhaat aur sheeshe jaise maaddon par stress aur strain parakhne ke liye istemal hote hain. Jab maadde par stress ho to us ki molecular banawat badalti hai, jo light se us ke taamul par asar karti hai, aur interference fringes banti hain jo maadde ke baare mein mayari (qualitative) maloomat deti hain. Shaffaf maadde se polarized light guzar kar aur us ki polarization ki tabdeeliyan parakh kar mahireen maadde ke stress ke patterns maloom kar sakte hain, mumkina kamzoriyan ya naqais pehchan sakte hain, us ki optical khusoosiyat parakh sakte hain, aur samajh sakte hain ke woh mukhtalif halaat mein kaisa rawayya rakhega. Is technique ko photoelasticity kehte hain aur yeh engineering, materials science aur quality control mein aam hai.

blocks.text: Dono sooraton mein polarizers khaas maqasid, chahe tasveer ka maiyar barhana ho ya maadde ki khusoosiyat parakhna, ke liye light ko qaboo karne mein aham kirdar ada karte hain. Polarized sunglasses bhi isi usool par kaam karte hain: highway se mun'akis light waves us ke mutawazi vibrate karti hain aur ruk jati hain, jabke highway ke amudi vibrate karti waves guzar jati hain.

blocks.caption: Malus ka qanoon ek nazar mein

blocks.prompt: 100 W m^-2 ki polarized beam 45 degrees par polarizer se guzarti hai; guzarti intensity nikalein. 15 W m^-2 ki unpolarized light do polaroids par parti hai jin ke axes amud se 50 aur 20 degrees par hain; har ek ke baad intensity nikalein. Unpolarized light chaar sheets se guzarti hai, har ek pichhli se 30 degrees ghumi hui; kitne feesad nikalti hai (numerical 8.2, 8.5, 8.9)?
blocks.explanation: I = 100 cos^2 45 = 50 W m^-2. Pehli sheet unpolarized light ka aadha, 7.5 W m^-2, guzarti hai; axes ka darmiyani zawiya 30 degrees hai, to doosri 7.5 cos^2 30 = 5.6 W m^-2 guzarti hai. Chaar sheets ke saath (1/2)(cos^2 30)^3 = 0.5 x 0.42 = 0.21, to 21 feesad nikalti hai.

blocks.prompt: Polaroid sunglasses aam sunglasses se behtar kyun hain, aur un ke design mein Malus ka qanoon kaise istemal hota hai (short question 8.1; constructed response 8.3)?
blocks.explanation: Aam rangeen chashme tamam light barabar kam karte hain. Sarak, pani ya gari ke bonnet se mun'akis chamak zyada tar sath ke mutawazi polarized hoti hai; polaroid lenses ke transmission axes amudi hote hain, to Malus ke qanoon se, chamak ki vibrations aur axis ke darmiyan theta = 90 degrees ke saath, I = I0 cos^2 90 = 0 aur chamak ruk jati hai jabke baqi manzar nazar aata rehta hai. Maslan geeli sarak dekhta driver roshan aks ki bajaye sarak saaf dekhta hai.

items: Malus ka qanoon: I = I0 cos^2 theta, A = A0 cos theta aur I = A^2 se; theta = 0 par I0, theta = 90 degrees par sifar. Polaroids (tourmaline, calcite) vibrations ek satah tak mehdood karte hain; reflection, refraction aur bikhrao bhi polarize karte hain.

Optical activity: quartz, cinnabar, cheeni ka pani, insulin, collagen satah ghumate hain; maadde, arhaaz, raste ki lambai, wavelength par munhasir; cheeni ka arhaaz napti hai. Misalein: n = 1.4; 56.25 W m^-2; 2.5 units. Istemalat: sunglasses, LCDs, microscopy, tib, astronomy, asmaan ki photography, photoelasticity.
